cases: metadata is saved before POST; same-frame and cross-instance new intents cannot duplicate
lost response survives remount; explicit GET recovers without POST or overwriting current conversation/draft
missing operation requires server DELETE fence before clearing; pending cannot be cleared
expired pending recovery becomes acknowledgeable and only a deliberate new submission uses a new UUID
quota429 clears only unadmitted matching intent and retains typed usage/CTA
wrong operation echo, malformed success/spec and body errors retain durable intent
actor change and auth A-B-A abort late response and isolate private results
unmount aborts transport while preserving pending metadata for a new mount
corrupted or unavailable storage blocks network; guest and stale retained callbacks do too
other tab storage updates block submits and clear obsolete displayed result
storage write failure and absent Web Locks never invoke provider
response capacity, invalid UTF8 and aborted streaming are bounded and retain intent
stalled response body terminates at deadline without releasing operation intent
